quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to say farewell with a friendly hand wave"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: You do this right before you leave for school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waving goodbye is a friendly way to say farewell.
quests.funFact: Waving goodbye is a friendly gesture used by people all around the world!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to carry plates and cups away after everyone finishes eating"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: Empty plates and cups get carried away for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Clearing the table means carrying away the empty plates and cups.
quests.funFact: Clearing the table is a helpful way to pitch in after a family meal!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to enjoy the last big meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This is usually the last meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Correct! We gather for dinner in the evening before getting ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to whisper sweet dreams to your family"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this to your family right before you close your eyes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good night to share a kind goodbye before we sleep.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to give your pet its breakfast before you leave"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: Your pet waits patiently for you to do this each day.
quests.explanation: Well done! Taking care of a pet is a kind daily responsibility.
quests.funFact: Feeding a pet at the same time each day helps it feel safe and happy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to stop dreaming and hop out of bed"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: This is the very first thing you do each morning, right after you stop dreaming.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wake up in the morning to start our fun new day.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to make your bed neat before you leave your room"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: Straightening blankets and lining up pillows are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Correct! We make our bed each morning right after we wake up.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to brush crumbs and dust into a tidy pile"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: Dust and crumbs are gathered into a small pile for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Sweeping means using a broom to gather dust into a pile.
quests.funFact: Sweeping right after a meal can help keep crumbs from spreading around the house!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Midday to take a break and enjoy a sandwich or snack"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: This meal happens in the middle of the day, not the morning or night.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat lunch in the middle of the day to refuel.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime is a great time to chat and laugh with your friends!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to gently move your arms and legs after sleeping"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You reach your arms up high and take a deep breath for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We stretch our body in the morning to wake up our muscles.
quests.funFact: Stretching gently in the morning can help wake up your whole body!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to make your space neat before you go to sleep"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: This covers your whole room, not just one small pile.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tidy our room in the evening to keep it neat and calm.
quests.funFact: A tidy room can help you find your favorite toys much faster the next day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to decide what shirt and pants to wear today"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: This happens before you actually put your clothes on.
quests.explanation: That's right! Choosing clothes means picking an outfit that fits the day.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather can help you choose whether to pick shorts or a warm sweater!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to add a warm layer before facing chilly weather"?
quests.question: Put on a Coat
quests.hint: This goes on over your shirt when it's cold outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on a coat to stay warm on a chilly day.
quests.funFact: Layering up with a coat traps warm air close to your body!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to pack something small and tasty for later on"?
quests.question: Pack a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a whole lunch, just a little extra.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack a snack in the morning for a little treat later on.
quests.funFact: Fruit, crackers, and cheese are popular choices for a packed snack!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to scrub plates and cups clean after a meal"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: You do this after a meal, not before.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing dishes means scrubbing plates and cups until they sparkle.
quests.funFact: Washing dishes right after a meal makes the food much easier to clean off!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to loop and tie your laces before you go outside"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: You do this right after your shoes go on your feet.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good knot keeps your shoes on tight while you run and play.
quests.funFact: Some sneakers use velcro instead of laces to make getting dressed even faster!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to travel to school on wheels with other students"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: You wait at a special stop before this begins.
quests.explanation: Well done! The bus carries lots of students to school together.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to rinse away germs before you eat"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: It helps stop tiny, sneaky germs from spreading.
quests.explanation: Well done! Clean hands help stop germs before we eat or play.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to help a houseplant stay green and healthy"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: A small watering can helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the plants so they stay green and healthy.
quests.funFact: Plants use water and sunlight together to make their own food and grow!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to find out if today will be warm or chilly"?
quests.question: Check the Weather
quests.hint: Clouds, sunshine, or rain are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We check the weather in the morning to plan what to wear.
quests.funFact: Weather can change from sunny to cloudy in just a single day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to fill your bag with books before school"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed backpack helps us feel ready for a great school day.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to swap your daytime clothes for cozy sleep clothes"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You wear these all night until morning comes.
quests.explanation: Correct! We change into pajamas at night, right before we go to sleep.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to smooth out any tangles from your pillow"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: It helps you look neat and tidy before school.
quests.explanation: Correct! We comb our hair each morning to get ready for the day.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make sure it's safe before crossing the street"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: You turn your head left, then right, for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We look both ways to check for cars before crossing the street.
quests.funFact: Crosswalks and traffic lights help keep everyone safe while crossing busy streets!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to smile and say hello to start the day"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: You say this cheerful greeting right after you wake up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good morning to greet our family as the day begins.
quests.funFact: A cheerful good morning can help set a happy tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to review what you learned in class that day"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: Your teacher usually gives this to you to finish at home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Homework helps us remember our lessons a little longer.
quests.funFact: Finding a quiet, comfy spot can make homework time easier to focus on!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to set a friendly reminder to wake up on time"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: A clock helps with this one, usually right before bed.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set an alarm at night to help us wake up on time.
quests.funFact: A gentle alarm sound can help you wake up feeling calm instead of startled!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to get your feet ready for walking and running"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Laces, velcro, or buckles help keep these snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Shoes protect our feet for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to fill your tummy before a busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: It gives your body energy to run, play, and learn.
quests.explanation: Correct! Eating breakfast gives our body the fuel it needs to start the day.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to travel to school on your own two feet"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: Holding a grown-up's hand can help keep you safe during this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Walking to school helps wake up our bodies before class.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!
